name: UTA Real-Life Drowsiness Dataset (UTA-RLDD)
origin: Vision-Learning-Mining Lab, University of Texas at Arlington, USA
data: RGB video from participant cellphones/webcams; 60 participants and 180 videos, approximately 30 hours.
labels: Participant-reported alert, low-vigilant, and drowsy clip classes; numeric codes 0, 5, 10 are category encodings.
limitation: Clip classes are not stress, mental health, or continuous KSS labels. Verify transfer to desk use.
access: Author page links to a Google Drive archive; listed at roughly 111 GB. Preserve participant folds.
rights: Verify research and redistribution terms. Only a subset of participant faces may be shown in publications according to the author page.

name: CogBeacon
origin: University of Texas at Arlington; author dataset repository
data: 19 participants, 76 sessions; EEG, facial keypoints, task performance, and fatigue reports.
labels: Cumulative participant button presses indicating difficulty keeping up, plus task outcomes; not KSS.
role: Collection-method reference and low-frequency cognitive-fatigue experiments.
limitation: 68 facial landmarks sampled at 2 FPS cannot resolve normal blink timing. EEG is unavailable in webcam-only deployment.
access: Repository describes data folders and linked analysis/data downloads; inspect completeness before use.
rights: Do not infer data/model rights from public visibility. Confirm terms for the intended use.

name: YawDD: Yawning Detection Dataset
origin: University of Ottawa; IEEE DataPort distribution
data: In-car RGB videos including quiet driving, speech/singing, and yawning; two camera placements.
labels: Mouth/activity conditions; inspect archive annotations and timing.
role: Mouth-event detection and hard negative examples for yawning.
limitation: Mouth opening and yawning are not a validated sleepiness or stress score.
access: IEEE DataPort listing requires login for dataset files; original paper 2014, DataPort record 2020.
rights: Listing describes research use. Check actual terms before redistribution or commercial deployment.
metadata_note: Original paper 2014; data record 2020. Author PDF returned 404; use DOI or dataset page.

name: UBFC-rPPG
origin: Univ. Bourgogne Franche-Comté, France; author-hosted dataset page
data: Webcam RGB with simultaneous pulse-oximeter waveform/rate reference; 8 videos in dataset 1 and 42 shared videos in dataset 2.
labels: Reference PPG waveform and pulse rate.
limitation: No fatigue/stress ground truth. Inspect reference synchronization and acquisition artifacts.
access: Author page links to data and reference-reading code.
rights: Research sharing stated; verify current permission and redistribution terms.
metadata_note: Dataset page credits recording to Macwan and Benezeth; associated paper authors are a separate credit. Publication appeared online in 2017 and journal issue in 2019; no dataset release year inferred.

name: COHFACE
data: 160 one-minute RGB videos from 40 subjects at 20 Hz, with physiological reference recordings.
labels: Synchronized blood volume pulse and respiration references.
role: External pulse-estimation test under another capture setup.
limitation: Different frame rate and conditions require explicit preprocessing and synchronization.
access: Zenodo record is public but dataset files are restricted; request access through the official route.
rights: Access must be granted under applicable terms. Public metadata is not blanket data permission.
metadata_note: Zenodo dataset record is dated 2016; linked paper version is 2017. Creator order differs from paper author order.

name: UBFC-Phys
origin: Université Bourgogne Franche-Comté, France; author page and institutional/IEEE data hosts
data: 56 participants; rest, speech, and arithmetic tasks; video with wrist BVP/EDA.
labels: Task conditions, physiological recordings, and pre/post self-reported anxiety scores.
limitation: Task identity or speaking may be a shortcut. Anxiety reports are not per-frame labels; wrist channels cannot become required webcam inputs.
access: Author page links to IEEE DataPort and dat@UBFC.
rights: Inspect the selected host’s dataset terms and permission requirements.
